comparison.objective: Measure shaft end play, select and insert a spacer, then verify clearance and rotation, versus tune and lock a shock absorber from dynamic response.
comparison.physical_skill: Referenced indicator handling, axial stop measurement, spacer selection/insertion, and shaft rotation differ from hex-key engagement, collar adjustment, and force-limited locking.
comparison.success_condition: Verified 2–4 mm end play and at least 60-degree retained-shaft rotation versus two non-bottoming, low-rebound carriage stops plus witness-tested setting retention.
comparison.reason: This is the closest measure-adjust-verify workflow, but it tests discrete spacer selection from static clearance rather than continuous damping adjustment from repeated impacts.
